_comment: __text baseline for the binary-size CI gate (see devkit bench size check and .github/workflows/binary_size.yml). Measured osx-arm64, 2026-10-03, on mojo 1.2.0.dev2026092105. Regenerate after an intentional size change with: pixi run -e dev python -m devkit bench size check --update. Re-recorded for the string_view/binary_view layouts, accepted as a deliberate cost: against main the comptime-lane gates grow 4.4-5.4% (query_streaming +73,408), query_cli +206,784 (+6.9%), and the runtime-lane gates query_streaming_agg +1,104,768 (+6.9%) and query_dynvalue +339,584 (+3.1%). Most of the comptime-lane share is the two new members in each erased box's variant (DynType, DynArray, DynBuilder, DynScalar), paid by binaries that never name a view; the rest is the view arms in the kernels' dispatch. main had itself grown query_streaming_agg +745,236 and query_dynvalue +745,820 past the previous floor (the regex and timezone kernels), which this re-recording also absorbs.
